name: kira-studio
description: Native macOS workbench: Kira Studio (DB + API client, ten engines) and Kira Space (git client, coding agents, workspace).
author: Vlad Cirstean

scripts.dev:studio: PATH="$PATH:$(go env GOPATH)/bin" sh -c 'cd apps/kira-studio && wails3 task dev'
scripts.dev:space: PATH="$PATH:$(go env GOPATH)/bin" sh -c 'cd apps/kira-space && wails3 task dev'
scripts.site:build: cd site && bun run check && bun run build
scripts.screenshots: bun run build:test:studio && bun run build:test:space && playwright test --config=apps/kira-studio/playwright.config.ts --project=screenshots && playwright test --config=apps/kira-space/playwright.config.ts --project=screenshots
scripts.build:space: cd apps/kira-space/frontend && bun run build && bun run build:mobile
scripts.proto:build:grid:hooks: cd apps/kira-studio/frontend && KIRA_DEBUG_HOOKS=1 KIRA_PROTO_OUT=dist-proto-hooks vite build --config vite.proto.config.ts
scripts.perf:probe:proto: bun run proto:build:grid && bun run proto:build:grid:hooks && playwright test --config=apps/kira-studio/playwright.perf.config.ts proto-grid-scroll
scripts.lint:rules: sh scripts/check-tokens.sh && sh scripts/check-theme-classes.sh && sh scripts/check-ui-primitives.sh && sh scripts/check-ade-colours.sh && bun scripts/check-class-conflicts.ts && bun scripts/check-conventions.ts && bun scripts/copy/check-copy.ts && bun scripts/copy/check-catalog.ts --unused && go run ./internal/llmprompts/cmd/checkprompts && bun site/scripts/check-docs.ts
scripts.lint:all: bun run lint && bun run lint:go && bun run lint:dead
scripts.typecheck: sh -c 'bun run typecheck:tests:studio & p1=$!; bun run typecheck:web:studio & p2=$!; bun run typecheck:space-web & p6=$!; bun run typecheck:space-mobile & p11=$!; bun run typecheck:unit:studio & p3=$!; bun run typecheck:space-unit & p7=$!; bun run typecheck:api-core:studio & p4=$!; bun run typecheck:git & p5=$!; bun run typecheck:space-tests & p8=$!; bun run typecheck:proto:studio & p9=$!; bun run typecheck:docker & p10=$!; bun run typecheck:copy & p12=$!; bun run typecheck:comments & p15=$!; bun run typecheck:site & p13=$!; bun run typecheck:docs-check & p14=$!; fail=0; wait $p1 || fail=1; wait $p2 || fail=1; wait $p6 || fail=1; wait $p11 || fail=1; wait $p3 || fail=1; wait $p7 || fail=1; wait $p4 || fail=1; wait $p5 || fail=1; wait $p8 || fail=1; wait $p9 || fail=1; wait $p10 || fail=1; wait $p12 || fail=1; wait $p13 || fail=1; wait $p14 || fail=1; wait $p15 || fail=1; exit $fail'
scripts.typecheck:git: tsgo --noEmit --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/tsbuildinfo/packages-git-ipc.tsbuildinfo -p packages/git-ipc/tsconfig.json && tsgo --noEmit --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/tsbuildinfo/packages-git-core.tsbuildinfo -p packages/git-core/tsconfig.json && vue-tsc --noEmit --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/tsbuildinfo/packages-git-ui.tsbuildinfo -p packages/git-ui/tsconfig.json
scripts.perf:http:studio: bun run build:studio && playwright test --config=apps/kira-studio/playwright.config.ts --project=perf http-response
scripts.perf:documents:studio: bun run build:studio && playwright test --config=apps/kira-studio/playwright.config.ts --project=perf documents-scroll
scripts.perf:parse:studio: bun run build:studio && playwright test --config=apps/kira-studio/playwright.config.ts --project=perf parse-callers
scripts.perf:ram:studio: bun run build:test:studio && playwright test --config=apps/kira-studio/playwright.perf.config.ts --project=heap heap-ram
scripts.perf:ram:space: bun run build:test:space && playwright test --config=apps/kira-space/playwright.perf.config.ts --project=heap heap-ram
scripts.test:unit: bun test apps/kira-studio/tests/unit apps/kira-space/tests/unit packages/api-core/test packages/git-core/src packages/git-ipc/src packages/git-ui/src packages/workbench/src packages/docker-ui/src packages/theme/src scripts/copy scripts/commentsweep scripts/check-conventions.spec.ts site/scripts
scripts.package:studio: PATH="$PATH:$(go env GOPATH)/bin" sh -c 'cd apps/kira-studio && wails3 task darwin:package:dmg && sh ../../scripts/sign-bundle.sh'
scripts.package:space: PATH="$PATH:$(go env GOPATH)/bin" sh -c 'cd apps/kira-space && wails3 task darwin:package:dmg && sh ../../scripts/sign-bundle.sh apps/kira-space "Kira Space"'
scripts.test:claude: bun run test:claude:space && bun run test:claude:studio
scripts.eval:memory: cd apps/kira-space/tests/claude && KIRA_MEMORY_EVAL=1 CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -v -count=1 -timeout 180m -run TestMemoryIngestEval ./...
scripts.lint:claude: sh scripts/install-golangci-lint.sh && for d in apps/kira-space/tests/claude apps/kira-studio/tests/claude; do (cd $d && "$(go env GOPATH)/bin/golangci-lint" run) || exit 1; done
scripts.dedup:go: git ls-files '*.go' | grep -v -e /page/wire/ -e /gitwire/ | go tool dupl -files -t 100
